title: Structured outputs for Anthropic Claude models on Amazon Bedrock
summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs for all Anthropic Claude models on both the bedrock-runtime and bedrock-mantle endpoints. Receive schema-compliant JSON that conforms to a defined structure, without custom parsing, retry logic, or post-processing, using JSON Schema
reason: AWS official blog announcing a non-model platform product capability: Bedrock now supports structured outputs for Claude models, with a link to the company's own announcement page. Not a new model/major version, so group 3 applies rather than group 1.
